key_insight: CurvDelta restricts model updates to a low-curvature space where preservation loss remains nearly unchanged, aiming to learn or forget targeted capabilities without degrading others.
engineering_relevance: It offers a geometry-aware approach to adapting LLMs when preserving existing capabilities is as important as achieving the new objective.
method: Analyze local curvature around the pre-adaptation model to identify preservation-friendly update directions.
Use Kronecker-factored approximate curvature (K-FAC) and factorized projection to make the construction scalable.
Introduce CurvLoRA, a low-rank variant using the same preservation geometry.
evidence_signal: Across mathematical reasoning, code generation, and TOFU/MUSE knowledge unlearning, the abstract reports improved acquisition–retention or forgetting–retention trade-offs, with unlearning retention close to from-scratch retraining.
watch_item: Preservation relies on a local, approximate curvature model; larger updates may leave the regime where preservation loss is nearly invariant.
paper_title: CurvDelta: Low-Curvature Delta Modeling For Surgical Learning and Unlearning
